title: Indigenous Language Mentorship I
description: 75-100 hours of mentorship with a fluent speaker or speakers to build oral fluency in an Indigenous language at the introductory level.
notes: Subject to the "Guidelines for Ethical Conduct" and "Regulations Concerning Practica".

items.text: Admission to one of BEd or Diploma program in Indigenous Language Revitalization, Certificate in Indigenous Language Proficiency, Certificate in Indigenous Language Revitalization
